lifetime_safety.details: Member order relays->webView->attachments matches the documented JUCE-safe reverse-destruction pattern. Editor runs on the message thread so stopTimer() in the dtor body precludes a mid-callback teardown race; timerCallback members (vizAnalyzer, webView) are alive when stopTimer runs. Resource-provider lambda capturing this is safe; makeBinaryResource copies static BinaryData.

binding_correctness.details: Relays registered via withOptionsFrom before WebView construction; attachment indices align (sliderRelays[i] <-> sliderIds[i]); 3-arg attachment form with nullptr undoManager. Null-param guard cannot desync indices, only silently disable a knob if an ID ever goes missing.

build_wiring.details: juce_add_binary_data target linked PRIVATE; all 6 SOURCES match getResource() paths and exist on disk; NEEDS_WEB_BROWSER + NEEDS_WEBVIEW2 TRUE; static-link WebView2 flag set; juce_gui_extra linked; Windows withUserDataFolder gated #if JUCE_WINDOWS.

rt_safety.details: timerCallback runs analyzer + builds var arrays on the message thread; webView null-guarded; no audio-thread allocation introduced by Stage 3.

issues.description: vizAnalyzer is declared above the relay/WebView/attachment cluster, so the load-bearing ordering comment (lines 39-45) only documents three of the lifetime-sensitive members. Harmless today (timer stopped before teardown), but a future tidy/refactor could reorder without realizing vizAnalyzer must outlive the WebView triad.
issues.fixSuggestion: Move vizAnalyzer declaration below the attachments so the lifetime-sensitive cluster is contiguous, or extend the comment to state vizAnalyzer must be declared before the triad. No behavioral change.

issues.description: The attachment loop skips any param whose getParameter() returns null with no diagnostic. Index alignment is preserved (relay i is still paired by index), so no desync, but a future param rename that compiles fine would yield a silently dead knob (no automation, no feedback). All 17 IDs are present today.
issues.fixSuggestion: Add jassert(param != nullptr) in both the slider and toggle binding loops so a missing/renamed ID fails loudly in debug instead of producing a silent dead control.

issues.description: stopTimer() in the dtor body is correct for the current synchronous timerCallback (single message thread = no mid-callback race), but the safety relies on the work staying synchronous. A future move to async dispatch (CallbackMessage) could outlive stopTimer().
issues.fixSuggestion: Defensive only: if viz work ever becomes async, add an alive flag set false before stopTimer() and early-return from timerCallback(). Not required now.

issues.description: Windows WebView2 user-data folder is named "OsimpleFM_WebView" while the product is O-simpleFM; minor casing/convention drift (PluginName_WebView). Temp dir, never user-visible.
issues.fixSuggestion: Rename to "O-simpleFM_WebView" for grep-ability and convention consistency across plugin temp dirs.

issues.description: Resource MIME types omit charset (e.g. text/html without ; charset=utf-8). WebView2/WKWebView default to UTF-8 so Unicode header glyphs render correctly today; purely defensive.
issues.fixSuggestion: Optionally append "; charset=utf-8" to the html/css/js MIME strings.
